dedupe_keys.name: gtfs reseau cap bus herault mediterranee

description: GTFS Réseau CAP'BUS - Hérault Méditerranée is a dataset listed in Hérault Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CA Hérault Méditerranée. Lien vers le fichier GTFS du réseau CapBus utilisé avec le fichier GTFS-RT (Zenbus) Offre de transport théorique du réseau Cap'Bus La Communauté d’Agglomération Hérault Méditerranée ouvre ses données publiques "Transport" afin de favoriser l’émergence d’applications dans le domaine. Coverage: Hérault. The portal files it under Routes, Transports et Mobilités. Its keywords are bus, Hérault Méditerranée, Agde, Pezenas. The portal shows 306 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-09-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-herault-data-fr-portal.
